expertCritique.attribution: Ben Thompson analysis, not an endorsement of this monitor
expertCritique.summary: Thompson argues residual-value support can protect supplier margins while transferring financing risk and exposing Nvidia to competing TPU/Trainium economics. The disclosed financing mechanism is verified separately with Nvidia; the claim that it effectively reduces prices is interpretation.
expertCritique.monitorDesign: Keep the supplier outside the hyperscaler capex score: supplier sales and customer capex represent overlapping transactions. Track gross margin, cash conversion, receivables, inventories, concentration and contingent support separately to test whether booked demand becomes independent end-user cash flow. Rising inventories/receivables alone do not prove a bubble; product ramps, mix and terms matter. Credit risk depends on enforceable support, collateral values and correlated customer stress, not headline financing targets.
